review_scope: Saved actual-app material/buffer evidence, private captured viewport, source semantics and final draft report text only. No application execution, extra asset import, renderer operation or geometry processing by this reviewer.

visual_review.observations: The actual Modly desktop viewport frames a recognizable upright brick-and-foliage object. Brown brick courses, dark gaps and irregular surrounding brown foliage are visible under the existing dim viewer lighting.
visual_review.limits: The object occupies a small portion of the capture. This is one framed view, not detailed inspection of every surface, an all-faces visibility proof, or pixel equivalence to the earlier Blender studio render. Exact colour-buffer identity and active original material routing support transport fidelity.

export_semantics.interpretation: The normal GLB export downloads the original served asset bytes. This does not demonstrate serialization of live BVH index order, edited materials or gizmo transforms.
export_semantics.completion_limit: The earlier download-progress snapshot alone is not final completion evidence; the report relies on separate completed-file verification.

session_scope.limits: These are whole-session CPU committed-memory and containment observations, not asset-import timing, a 180-second CPU-worker result, dedicated VRAM, model-level disposal proof or graceful termination of every backend child.

startup_and_authorship: This reviewer authored the temporary observer and its mocked tests. Those tests missed the cold-renderer Page.enable/navigation dependency. The recorded blank-page recovery is a diagnostic startup intervention, not unassisted-startup acceptance or a demonstrated product defect. This material review assesses saved actual observations and does not independently reapprove its own observer source.
